publication_scope: Documentation and derived evidence only; experimental engine and adapter changes are not deployed by this publication.
measurement_scope: Iterative development of one recovered 76-file application under a 12-criterion plan; not independent fresh-run trials or a model ranking.
counting_policy: Reference, candidate, synthetic controls and mocked CPU checks are separate. Repeated and overlapping batches must not be added into a unique-test count or aggregate success rate.
ui_execution: Pinned Vitest/jsdom mounted UI integration with real HTTP services; real browser and visual-layout evaluation unavailable.
evidence_availability: Allowlisted measurements and selected original receipt SHA-256 hashes. Raw journals, prompts, responses, private source and operational identifiers remain unpublished. Hashes alone do not permit independent replay.
hardware: One RTX 3090, 24576 MiB; model roles sequential.
